voice.speaker: Ryan
voice.instruct: Calm, clear and friendly, like a good teacher explaining an idea for the first time. Steady pace.

beats.s0b0: A function draws a curve, and its steepness can change from place to place.
beats.s0b1: To measure it at one point, draw the line that just touches the curve there.
beats.s0b2: The slope of that tangent line tells us the function’s instantaneous rate of change.
beats.s1b0: Now slide the touching point along the curve; the tangent pivots as the curve bends.
beats.s1b1: At each position, its slope—and therefore the derivative—can be different.
beats.s1b2: So the derivative, f prime of x, is the slope of the tangent line at x.
